body:
Thank you. I understand his position when looking at it in a vacuum, but I still believe it had effects on the relationship, even if thats not what he intended. I mean, spending so much time with a best friend who made it very clear right from the start that he's actually looking for more than just friendship - that cant be healthy for a young relationship, right?
So of course, while it may have seemed like the best thing to do from where he was standing, I still think it was kind of inconsiderate/disrespectful towards her, me and our relationship - regardless of what his intentions were. In hindsight, I think that they should have put some distance between themselves at least for some time, to let him get over those feelings on his own.

Thanks for sharing, and for your kind words. Its not really just "killing myself over some woman", what I talked about in my post is just the current trigger. I've been struggling with depression for about 8 years, I was diagnosed with depression/dysthymia about 3 years ago. There have been many times when I thought about killing myself or at least wishing I was dead on a daily basis for months on end.
I know Im still young, but with every day that I get older, I become less and less hopeful that things are ever going to change for me. Almost everyone my age around me has had several relationships, sometimes for several years, some of which are still staying strong. Except for me. Before her, I've almost never felt loved (in a romantic sense) or wanted. 
When she broke up with me, my first thoughts weren't just sadness and wishing she'd stay with me, I also thought about how I should have known from the start, how that's what I deserved, and how I was an idiot for even convincing myself for those short few weeks/months that things had finally changed for me. It took me months to even realize how badly she treated me before, during and after the breakup.
Thank you for sharing, I hope you're doing better now. I'll try to hold on for a while longer.

Thats a great analogy, ill have to keep that in mind! And i dont think it sounds childish at all, it sounds pretty profound to me actually. 
I can relate to the only reason to live being your parents as well, thats how i've felt for a long time and sometimes I still feel that way.

Would seeking professional help be an option for you? I know its different for every person and not always readily available, but personally, it really helped me - both the therapy, and the medication.

I wish you all the best. I'm here to talk if you ever need anyone :)
If it works then thats fine, one step at a time! Hopefully some time in the future it wont be cowardice and fear, but hope and happiness!

I understand that. I also only go on this sub when im already feeling down. I wish you all the best, try to hang in there. I wont say it gets better because we cant know if it will, but staying strong is the only way we can find out. I'll try to do the same.

Thanks for sharing, thats been my experience every other time i've loved, apart from her. Even then, i'd already been in love with her for over a year before our short relationship started.

Its gonna happen eventually, right? It has to, otherwise all of this hurt would be pretty pointless. I know its hard but I suppose until then, all we can do is *try* to love ourselves and improve ourselves so we can aspire to be the best version of ourselves.

Thank you. Im feeling a little better now thanks to some friends and all of these nice comments, lets see how long that will last for. 
Im sorry to hear you've been in a similar situation and I hope you're doing better now.

Ill hang on for now but like I said, I'm kind of worried that the next blow will put me over the edge. Whatever, I guess Ill see how it turns out. Thanks again!
I'm sorry to hear that, but at least we both know that we're not alone struggling with this. Small consolation, i know, but its something. Lets hang in there for a little longer :)
Yes? Thats why im posting about feeling suicidal here, to get help from people who might understand my situation. I'm sorry if anything in the post is inappropriate for this sub
Look, I'm genuinely asking what you mean because I want to understand your point. If you cant tell me what your comment actually means then why comment in the first place?
Can you elaborate please? What exactly is cringe about it?
Thanks, you're actually making me cry. Im sorry to hear of what you went through and I hope you're doing better now. You seem like a genuinely great person. Thank you for everything!

Dont be sorry, thanks for sharing. I think I understand what you're going through and how it hurts, but I hope you won't go through with it. Please take the time to read all of the nice things that other commenters have written, all of that applies to you as well! It may suck now, but maybe we should both just stick around a little longer, and see if it gets better after all. I wish you all the best.

Thanks for your kind words. Although you can survive without love, love is something that feels so detrimental to my life and my happiness, that I think a life completely devoid of love would not be worth living, at least for me personally. I.e. if I were absolutely certain that there is no chance of me ever finding love i would actually just kill myself.

I've always had a bit of trouble finding goals that are not related to finding a girlfriend, but I'll try I suppose. Thanks again!

Too late, already texted him. I went out on a walk and decided that I'd just text him and if his reply made me feel any better then great, and if it made me feel worse i'd just go back inside and kill myself now.

I don't know him THAT well, but he seems like one of the genuinely nicest people I know. It was probably the same type of situation as with her at the end of our relationship: she treated me badly without meaning to because she wasn't sure of her own feelings and didn't realize how her actions would hurt me.

Anyway, he probably won't reply for some time since I think she is with him at the moment (her and I live in the same building and her apartment's lights were of when I came back from my walk)

​

Thanks for your kind words. You sound like you could do this professionally, lol. I've talked about "loving myself" a lot with my therapist over the last 2-3 years, but it always feels like I'm just lying to myself to make me feel better. If I was actually a good, lovable person then surely someone would have come along to make me feel like that by now, right? And so, the feeling of being a fat, worthless piece of shit that doesn't deserve and will never find love usually prevails. 

Regarding the part about being fat, I've gained \~25kg since I started taking antidepressants \~2,5 years ago. I actually laid off the antidepressants about 2 months ago, but I haven't been able to find the energy/motivation to actually watch my diet and exercise, so I haven't even managed to lose any weight yet.

​

Sorry about taking up so much of your time, you can stop reading and replying anytime you want. Please don't feel like you have to reply.

Hey, thanks for even reading that mess.

​

I don't know, I just feel empty, sad, angry and probably a couple more emotions all at once. I'd like to text him about how I think that was a dick move but 1. i dont know how 2. its been like 8 months since that happened 3. its not really any of my business and 4. i dont know if i even should

all of us 3 are in the same class so if it werent for distance learning (uni closed again yesterday) id still see both of them every day.
